Spacious 3-Bedroom Apartment | Park Horizon Tower 2

Discover modern urban living in this beautifully designed 3-bedroom apartment located in Park Horizon Tower 2. Spanning 1,355.82 sq. ft., this home offers a perfect balance of space, comfort, and contemporary style.

The apartment features a bright and airy open-plan living and dining area, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Large windows allow plenty of natural light, enhancing the welcoming atmosphere throughout the home. The well-appointed kitchen offers ample storage and functional layout, perfect for home cooking.

All three bedrooms are generously sized, with built-in wardrobes and a thoughtfully planned layout that ensures privacy and comfort. The master bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom, while the additional bedrooms share a modern family bathroom. High-quality finishes and neutral tones create a refined, move-in-ready feel.

Residents of Park Horizon Tower 2 enjoy access to premium amenities, including a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, landscaped areas, and dedicated parking. The tower is ideally located with easy access to major roads, retail outlets, schools, and everyday conveniences.
